_help: Act 3, stage two on the desert road: the temple or the town.
title: The desert road divides
intro: Eleanor wants the temple. A guide would want the town.

options.label: The ancient temple
options.desc: Ruins that may say something about Akmentar. Investigating could cost time; leave at once and you keep your lead.

options.label: The small town
options.desc: Water, food and supplies. Safer, the guide says, though strangers have been asking about expeditions.
